title: Overcoming Combinatorial Explosion in Alloy Design via Hierarchical Multi-Agent Systems

contributions.purpose: 用分层多智能体系统重构合金发现流程
contributions.mechanism: FamilyAgent/StoichiometryAgent/RefereeAgent + 三创新(炉子反馈在线学习、curiosity-annealing 调度、记忆注入生成器)
contributions.domain: AI 材料发现 / 多智能体
contributions.source_quote: a hierarchical multi-agent system (MAS) that fundamentally redesigns this architecture through three innovative mechanisms

contributions.mechanism: 对比 Random Search/MatGPT/AtomAgent/AlloyDB RF 基线的(模拟)炉子迭代数
contributions.evaluation: 声称减少 7 倍 physical lab iterations(实为模拟迭代)
contributions.source_quote: reduces required physical lab iterations by seven-fold compared to both single-agent and static multi-agent baselines

contributions.purpose: 发现新型 Pareto 最优合金
contributions.mechanism: 多目标(强度/导电/耐蚀)+ 新颖度奖励维护 Pareto 前沿
contributions.evaluation: 21 个新 Pareto 最优合金,97.3% 冶金可行性,novel hit-rate 34/100(均模拟)
contributions.source_quote: The system identified 21 novel Pareto-optimal alloys that outperform canonical benchmarks (Ti-6Al-4V, Inconel-718, Cantor HEA) while maintaining 97% metallurgical feasibility.

self_declared_provenance.quote: Unlike prior multi-agent systems in materials science that maintain static agent behaviors (3), our architecture features specialized agents—FamilyAgent, StoichiometryAgent, and RefereeAgent—that dynamically adapt their strategies based on experimental feedback.

notes: 重大数据红旗:全流程为纯模拟——方法节自认 'experiment simulators (E)'、'E predicted material properties via Gradient Boosting models',不存在真实炉子/真实实验;却将结果包装为 'From Simulation to Foundry'、'The results... transcend simulation; they represent empirically validated materials'、'learns directly from physical experimental outcomes'、'furnace runs'——虚假实证框架(simulated baseline)。circular self-validation:代理系统既生成候选又用同一代理 surrogate 评分,基线(Random Search/MatGPT/AtomAgent/AlloyDB RF)亦为模拟。'seven-fold' 与 '21 alloys / 97% feasibility' 均为模拟内自证。physics-guided property models 实为启发式(强度=难熔元素计数等)。系统名 ODL-DSP v4.0 疑似复用/换皮。
